title: Optimising two-block averaging kernels to speed up Markov chains
summary: We study the problem of selecting optimal two-block partitions to accelerate the mixing of finite Markov chains under group-averaging transformations. The main objectives considered are the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence and the Frobenius distance to stationarity. We establish explicit connections between these objectives and the induced projection chain. In the case of the KL divergence, this reduction yields explicit decay rates in terms of the log-Sobolev constant.
